summary.name: Udio
summary.one_liner: Udio is an AI music generator that creates full songs from text descriptions and lets users upload audio for AI editing and share their tracks with a community.
keywords: make a song from a prompt
use_cases: generating personalized songs from a text description
making a birthday or celebration song
editing uploaded audio with AI tools
publishing and sharing songs with a music community
music production ideas for musicians and songwriters
summary.what_it_does: Udio lets users describe a song in text and generates music from that description, with the page citing examples such as ballads, dance tracks, and lo-fi tracks. Users can upload their own audio and use the site's AI-editing tools. Finished songs can be published on Udio, where users can follow artists and browse other creators' tracks. The page showcases a feed of community-created songs with titles and creator names. It states that professional musicians and amateurs both use it in production.
notable: Public publishing and follow-artists community feed
caveats: Pricing tiers are not described on the page; freemium status comes from the directory listing
Page does not state supported output formats, song length limits, or licensing terms
